content.value_statement: Stripe API choices change as products evolve, which can lead to outdated payment designs. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward current Stripe integration patterns.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Checkout Sessions for on-session payments and subscriptions.
Explains when PaymentIntents, SetupIntents, Payment Links, Invoicing, and Billing APIs fit.
Steers migrations away from Charges, Sources, legacy Card Element, and token-based card saving.
Guides payment method choices with dynamic payment methods and Payment Element guidance.
Summarizes Stripe Connect charge-type choices and controller property terminology.
limitations: Does not replace Stripe documentation, legal advice, or PCI compliance review.
Does not verify account settings, dashboard configuration, or live API behavior.
Does not generate a complete production integration by itself.
May require current Stripe docs for new products or regional changes.

use_cases.title: Choose Payment APIs
use_cases.description: Select Checkout Sessions, PaymentIntents, SetupIntents, Billing, or Payment Links for a new integration.

use_cases.title: Plan Subscription Flows
use_cases.description: Map recurring revenue requirements to Stripe Billing and Checkout before implementation.

use_cases.title: Design Connect Platforms
use_cases.description: Compare direct charges and destination charges while using current Connect terminology.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Payment Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Stripe best practices skill to recommend the simplest current payment flow for a one-time online purchase.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Subscription Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my SaaS subscription plan and identify which Stripe Billing and Checkout APIs I should prioritize.

prompt_templates.title: Modernize a Legacy Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my legacy Stripe approach for Charges, Sources, tokens, or Card Element usage, then suggest modern migration paths.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Connect Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate a marketplace design that uses Stripe Connect, fund flows, liability assumptions, and connected account capabilities.

output_examples.input: I need to accept one-time card payments for a new online store.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: use Stripe-hosted Checkout with Checkout Sessions for the first release. Add dynamic payment methods and confirm your go-live checklist before launch.

output_examples.input: My legacy site stores cards with Sources.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: migrate away from Sources. Use SetupIntents for saved payment methods and review Stripe migration guidance before changing customer payment data.

output_examples.input: I am building a marketplace and need to route funds to sellers.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: choose destination charges when the platform accepts negative-balance responsibility, or direct charges when connected accounts should carry risk.

best_practices: Start from Stripe Checkout and Checkout Sessions unless the product needs deeper payment form control.
Use current Stripe APIs and migration guidance before recommending legacy integration surfaces.
Validate production readiness with Stripe go-live, webhook, tax, discount, and payment method settings.
anti_patterns: Recommending Charges, Sources, or token-based card saving for new card payment integrations.
Hard-coding specific payment method types when dynamic payment methods can select better options.
Mixing Stripe Connect charge types without a clear liability and merchant-of-record model.

faq.question: Can this skill help choose between Checkout and Payment Element?
faq.answer: Yes. It prioritizes Checkout and explains when Payment Element may be appropriate for advanced customization.

faq.question: Does it handle subscriptions?
faq.answer: Yes. It points recurring revenue designs toward Stripe Billing, Subscription APIs, and Checkout where they fit.

faq.question: Will it write complete payment code?
faq.answer: It provides implementation guidance, but users still need project-specific code, testing, and Stripe documentation.

faq.question: Can it advise on PCI compliance?
faq.answer: It can flag PCI-sensitive patterns, but it is not a compliance audit or legal review.

faq.question: Does it support Stripe Connect platforms?
faq.answer: Yes. It summarizes recommended charge types, controller properties, capabilities, and fund-flow considerations.

faq.question: Should it use the latest Stripe API?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill directs users to default to current API and SDK versions unless a user specifies otherwise.
